summary: Chat template + tokenization -> AsyncLLM.generate (chatcmpl-v1, max_tokens 16) -> ADD to engine core -> scheduler/rank0 worker for 16 steps -> check_stop FINISHED_LENGTH_CAPPED -> 16 incremental detokenizer updates -> chat.completion, finish_reason length, usage 14/16/30. Reproduced end to end with the busy loop running.

Events are right (role chunk, content deltas, finish_reason length, usage chunk, data: [DONE]), but the model awaits AsyncLLM.generate to completion and then fabricates one chunk per word of the final text; the code iterates generate's per-step DELTA outputs inside the stream generator after the 200 is sent. Mid-stream errors therefore become HTTP errors in the model, data chunks in the code. The finish_reason also travels in a separate empty-delta chunk instead of with the last delta.

Corrected: 400 with type BadRequestError (not invalid_request_error), raised by the renderer's _token_len_check (VLLMValidationError) before AsyncLLM.generate is called. Model: base-renderer.tokenize-prompt fails with BadRequestError/400 and the same message; generate, input processor and engine core never called.

404 NotFoundError 'The model `gpt-4o` does not exist. Valid aliases: llama-8b.' from _check_model after the LoRA lookup, before _preflight/rendering/generate. The HF repo id is also refused when --served-model-name is set; the model reproduces both.

Disconnect at 260 ms (after ~4 tokens): generate's await is cancelled, AsyncLLM.abort drops the output-processor state, ABORT reaches engine-core-proc, scheduler.finish_requests then kv-cache-manager.free; req_to_blocks empty. Caveat: in the code a streaming disconnect is detected by Starlette's StreamingResponse, not with_cancellation (the model routes it through with_cancellation's token because it has no real stream).

Greedy decision is modeled (temperature 0 reaches sampler.add-request on rank0; only the Gumbel argmax kernel runs, no temperature/top-k/top-p/min-p kernels), but two identical temperature-0 requests return different completions: sampler.sample returns random(128000)+100 for every row regardless of sampling type. Correction: argmax is repeatable for identical logits; across different batch compositions only with VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT (sampling_params.py:603-610).

Expectation confirmed (stop string excluded by default; finish_reason stop). Through /v1/chat/completions the model drops `stop`: create-chat-completion builds sampling_params from max_tokens, n and temperature only, so generation runs to length (16 tokens, finish_reason length). The engine half is right: the same stop list sent straight to async-llm-generate ends with finish_reason stop, text truncated before the stop string and an ABORT to the engine core (bench-v7-engine passes).

Corrected: the error is specifically 503 (EngineDeadError mapped by health.py:31-33). Model: /health 200, then a real engine death (execute_model fault on step 2 -> busy loop dies -> client engine_dead) -> /health 503 via async-llm.check-health; also 503 when the output-handler task is done (is_running false).
